key_facts: ATF, DEA, and FBI allow nonfederal officers to engage in task force operations before completing initial task force officer training.
The four DOJ components lack guidelines and criteria for field managers to adjudicate misconduct allegations against nonfederal task force officers.
DOJ law enforcement agencies partner with thousands of nonfederal officers from state, local, tribal, and territorial law enforcement agencies through task forces.
GAO reviewed a nongeneralizable sample of eight task forces based on task force type and location, and interviewed officials from four DOJ components.
